missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency/error metrics or spans for /v1/authorizations
Order service internal timing to confirm payment is the blocking hop
candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s; order in turn times out calling payment, whose authorization call exceeds the client timeout. Payment is the deepest slow hop.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side spans/metrics; payment latency inferred from client ReadTimeout and the later 200 authorization span.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 driven by order ReadTimeout (~2s), and order's payment call also ReadTimeout; inventory/redis succeed fast. Gateway logs confirm 502s with transport errors to order. Consistent with downstream latency at payment, but payment-side telemetry is absent, so confidence is moderate.
